config.flyhigher.title: Fly Higher Config
config.flyhigher.height_multiplier.toolt: Scale altitude distances from the 1.0 atm anchor point (1.0 = default, 2.0 = double height, 0.5 = half height)
config.flyhigher.weather_pressure.toolti: Lower air pressure while it is raining, and lower it further during a thunderstorm. Disabled by default; applied in real time with no /reload needed.
config.flyhigher.rain_multiplier.tooltip: Pressure multiplier during rain (1.0 = unchanged, 0.9 = 10% lower).
config.flyhigher.thunder_multiplier.tool: Pressure multiplier during a thunderstorm (1.0 = unchanged, 0.75 = 25% lower).
